text:
elaine (sales): Quick help — ACME enterprise deal asking for capacity plan. They expect ~80 req/s sustained with short spikes up to ~400 req/s (30s bursts). They want reserved GPUs + autoscale runway + preheat guidance and a simple cost delta for 2:1 vs 4:1 batching. Also asking about security questionnaire items (KMS/VPC/audit). cc @micah @devon @jia
micah (solutions): ok. two quick q's: what's the avg tokens per request (resp and context)? and what's the p95 latency target?
elaine (sales): avg response ~40 tokens, using a 32k-context model, target p95 <= 300ms.
devon (infra): rough thumb: for a 32k Llama-style model on A100 class, 2 GPUs handle ~80–100 rps with tight batching. To reliably absorb 400rps 30s bursts you want reserved pool + burst credits + prewarm. Suggest: reserved min 2 gpus, reserved target 4 gpus for headroom, autoscale up to 8 for extreme bursts.
micah (solutions): latency vs batching note: 2:1 batching -> lower p95, 4:1 batching -> better throughput but p95 typically +50–80ms. recommend adaptive batching (default 2:1, allow 4:1 when GPU util <70%).
devon (infra): proposed autoscale policy snippet:
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 2
  target_replicas: 4
  max_replicas: 8
  step: 2
  target_rps_per_gpu: 40
  cooldown_s: 60
  burst_mode: true  # uses burst credits and short-lived prewarmed instances
```
devon (infra): preheat plan: KV-cache warmup script + a warm window 5m before known high-traffic periods. For ad-hoc spikes rely on burst credits + fast scale (step=2, cooldown 60s). Also add queue depth limit so we fail-fast instead of queuing for >1s.
jia (security): security Qs from ACME: KMS integration, VPC peering or PrivateLink, audit logs retention (they asked 7 yrs), SOC2 + subprocessor list, and data residency (eu-west-1). Dedicated supports KMS + VPC and audit logging. Private deployment if they require air-gapped or stronger controls. Any contractual blockers for retention?
elaine (sales): they'll take Dedicated if cost delta and SLA look good. I'll loop legal. Can someone produce a short one-pager: sizing + cost delta (reserved4 vs payg) + autoscale policy + security bullets?
devon (infra): I'll produce the POC runbook + perf numbers (load profile, batch configs, kv-warm scripts). cost back-of-envelope: 4xA100 reserved ~ +30% vs fully spot/payg for steady load but saves on p95 guarantees. I'll add exact numbers.
micah (solutions): i'll draft the 1-pager and call out batching tradeoffs and latency knobs, include example curl + SDK snippet for adaptive batching.
jia (security): i'll pull SOC2 + KMS integration docs and flag anything that requires legal change. If they need 7yr retention we may need add-on for log storage.
deploy-bot: INF-4567 created: provisioning request for ACME POC env (reserved pool=4, autoscale config=as discussed).
elaine (sales): perfect — action items: @devon POC artifacts & numbers, @micah 1-pager + pricing blurb, @jia security docs, and i'll coordinate with sales lead and legal. ETA: EOD tomorrow for initial artifacts. thanks! :thumbsup:
